title_zh: Zcash NU7 升级主网激活（目标日）
desc_zh: 开发团队已把 NU7 主网激活高度定为 3,543,405（预计 11 月 5 日前后），区块时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，并禁用 v4 交易；Sprout 遗留池中未及时转移的 ZEC 将无法花费。注意：截至 10 月 21 日该提案仍在评审中，激活高度须正式写入部署规范后才最终确定。
desc_en: Zcash developers set the NU7 mainnet activation height at block 3,543,405 (~Nov 5), cutting block time from 75s to 25s and disabling v4 transactions; ZEC left in the legacy Sprout pool becomes unspendable. Note: as of Oct 21 the proposal is still under review and isn't final until merged into the deployment spec.

title_zh: 英国央行利率决议（预期加息至 4%）
title_en: Bank of England rate decision (hike to 4.0% expected)
desc_zh: 英国央行周四公布利率决议，路透调查的经济学家预期加息至 4.0%（现 3.75%），为 2023 年 8 月以来首次加息；决议结果与全球加息潮一道影响本周风险资产情绪。
desc_en: The Bank of England decides on Thursday; economists in a Reuters poll expect a hike to 4.0% from 3.75%, its first since August 2023. The decision lands amid a global round of rate hikes and will feed into risk-asset sentiment this week.

title_zh: Mercado Bitcoin 遭窃后分阶段恢复（首阶段仅只读查账）
title_en: Mercado Bitcoin phased reopening after hack (read-only access first)
desc_zh: 巴西最大交易所 Mercado Bitcoin 11 月 2 日遭窃后暂停充提与交易，Bitquery 追踪被盗约 4860 万美元（跨 10 条链），攻击在官方称已控制后仍持续约 4 小时；11 月 9 日起首阶段仅恢复网站只读访问（查余额、账单与持仓），转账、提现与交易继续暂停，何时恢复取决于独立安全检查，暂无日期。交易所承诺以自有资金补足用户损失。
desc_en: After the Nov 2 hack, Brazil's largest exchange Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits, withdrawals and trading; Bitquery traced about $48.6M stolen across 10 chains, with the attack running ~4 hours after the exchange said it was contained. From Nov 9, phase one restores read-only website access (balances, statements, holdings) only; transfers, withdrawals and trading stay suspended pending independent security checks, with no dates given. The exchange pledges to cover losses from company funds.
Released 8:30 AM ET. Hotter-than-expected inflation pressures risk assets.
